meta.title: Rummel Technologies — Your Personal Operating System
meta.description: Rummel Technologies builds AI-powered personal productivity apps — fitness, nutrition, home, work, finance, and more — that work standalone or together as your personal operating system.

hero.title:
Every part of your life,
intelligently organized.
hero.subtitle: Ten apps covering fitness, nutrition, home, work, finance, and more. Use each one on its own, or connect them all through Artemis — your personal AI operating system.

apps.name: Artemis
apps.description: Your AI-powered personal operating system. Artemis orchestrates all your apps with a conversational agent, unified dashboard, and cross-app intelligence. The more apps you connect, the smarter it gets.

apps.name: Workout Planner
apps.description: AI-generated training plans that adapt to your recovery, readiness, and goals. Full Apple Health integration tracks HRV, sleep, and workout history to optimize every session.

apps.name: Meal Planner
apps.description: Personalized meal planning and nutrition tracking that automatically adjusts your calorie targets based on your workouts. Generate shopping lists and manage recipes with ease.

apps.name: Home Manager
apps.description: Stay on top of household tasks, maintenance schedules, and home inventory. Smart reminders surface the right task at the right time so nothing slips through the cracks.

apps.name: Vehicle Manager
apps.description: Track maintenance schedules, fuel costs, and trip logs for all your vehicles. Automated reminders for oil changes, inspections, and registration so you're never caught off guard.

apps.name: Work Planner
apps.description: Structured work planning for both corporate and entrepreneurial endeavors. Manage projects, priorities, and weekly rhythms in a single focused workspace built for deep work.

apps.name: Education Planner
apps.description: Set meaningful learning goals and build weekly study plans that fit your life. Track progress across courses, books, certifications, and self-directed study with clarity and momentum.

apps.name: Focus Training
apps.description: Build your focus like a muscle. Gamified sessions with XP, levels, and achievements make deep work rewarding. Progressively longer intervals train sustainable concentration over time.

apps.name: Content Planner
apps.description: Curate an intentional audio-first media diet. Queue podcasts, audiobooks, and lectures aligned to your education and growth goals — not whatever the algorithm serves next.

apps.name: Investment Manager
apps.description: Portfolio tracking, performance analysis, and tax insights in one place. Monitor your investments with clear visualizations of allocation, returns, and realized gains — without the noise.
